assets.name: nba_schedule_2027.parquet
assets.purpose: Schedule, status and full-game final scores for unchanged score/date features

atomicity: Complete all capture/schema/identity/history/model checks before pointer swap; failure skips all publication that invocation. Per-game render failures isolated after whole-bundle admission.
attribution: SportsDataverse / hoopR, ESPN-derived records. CC BY 4.0 data; retain attribution, license and changes disclosure. No endorsement. Retained source approval remains authoritative.

cadence.corrections: Daily/status checks discover content changes; rebuild current-season history from complete snapshot with predecessor lineage; no refit.
cadence.daily: First owner tick at/after 10:00 America/New_York; one successful validation satisfies that day.
cadence.freshness: Due games: refresh at 23h age; final hour at 90m age. Global minimum spacing and ceilings apply.
cadence.notDue: Zero network intent; no download on ordinary 15-minute ticks.
cadence.postFinal: First check at/after scheduled tipoff+4h (not assumed FINAL); unresolved status checks at >=2h age for at most 48h; accept only source FINAL.
cadence.preseasonOpening: First refresh T-7 days minus 60 minutes before earliest admitted regular tipoff; no earlier calls.
cadence.publicationLead: Revalidate between 60 minutes before each T-7d/T-24h/T-6h/T-1h checkpoint and checkpoint if no validation since lead start.
cadence.sourceCadenceQualification: No published update SLA established by retained evidence. Cadence is a bounded polling policy, not a claim of hourly upstream updates.

conditionalRequests.status200Changed: New physical object and revision lineage; admit whole snapshot atomically before publication.
conditionalRequests.status200SameHash: Reuse original object and acquisition clock; actual revalidation recorded separately.
conditionalRequests.status304: Retain prior object reference and original acquisition clock; new immutable actual-revalidation receipt, zero duplicate raw bytes.

fieldUse: Identity/status read first; scores only for metadata-selected regular-season FINAL records. Cup championship date-only context. No boxes, odds, injuries or player inputs.

freshness.meaning: 304 validates server version only. Missing finals block admission; original acquisition clocks never changed.

limitsScope: New prospective grant only, not a reset/reuse of previous historical allowances. Meter redirect requests and response body bytes; reserve maxima durably before request. No NBA.com, nba_api, team-box or paid endpoints.
quarantine: Access refusal, physical schema drift, identity/score inconsistency and unresolved interrupted HTTP stop. No retry loop. Retain failure/raw bytes privately and preserve admitted pointer. SOURCE_FINAL_PENDING is a status gap, reconsider only after next bounded changed capture.
redirectRules: Only Location from preceding allowed request; HTTPS; no credentials; at most 3 redirects. Signed queries transport-only, never retained. No other API or discovery URLs.
retention: Private append-only source objects, capture/admission receipts and input projections outside Git. 5 GiB aggregate across refresh/ and input registry, with 32 MiB admission headroom reserved before capture. No automatic deletion; stop on capacity. Existing forecast populations, launcher/runner evidence and exchange retain the publisher retention policy, outside this acquisition allowance. No raw exchange upload.

seasonCoverage.baseHistory: Frozen admitted history through completed 2025-26; not reacquired
